adapted_to: voiceprint agent decisions, not student grading

splits.validation: first 20 LibriSpeech test-clean speakers, used to compare embedders
splits.locked: next 20 test-clean speakers, reported separately and not used to choose an embedder

adoption_rule: On validation verify cases, the paired bootstrap 95% interval of accuracy must lie above 0, false-accept rate must not rise by more than 0.02, and every security check must still pass.
primary_metric: verify accuracy, where uncertain and missing decisions are incorrect

case_rules.probe: from a chapter the enrollment did not use whenever the speaker has one; single-chapter speakers are marked probe_session=same
case_rules.verify: balanced: one genuine and one impostor trial per speaker; this is the primary metric
case_rules.verify_impostor: every other speaker of the split claims the name; measures false accepts only
case_rules.verify_short / verify_noise: one genuine and one impostor trial per speaker
case_rules.uncertain: never counted as a correct automatic decision, in identification as in verification
